facts.fact: UNDP's 2024 annual report records that the government launched the development of the National Strategy for Digital Transformation, with UNDP support, on 5 July 2024.
UNDP's 2024 annual report says the strategy has six pillars and 55 priority interventions with clear implementation milestones, with no cost stated.
UNDP's 2024 annual report says the strategy was launched with UNDP support and financing from the Government of Japan.
